name: Amitry Product & Category Slider for WooCommerce
author: amitry

sections.description:
Amitry Product & Category Slider for WooCommerce provides a native Gutenberg block AND an Elementor widget that let you showcase your WooCommerce product categories or products as a smooth, modern, fully configurable carousel — without shortcodes, and without compromising on design quality.

Key Features

  • Two Slider Modes: Categories or Products
  • Works in Gutenberg AND Elementor: Same output, same settings, your choice
  • Category Sorting: Sort by name, product count, or menu order
  • Title Styling: Custom text color and background color for titles
  • Customizable “View All” Button: Style (filled/ghost), icon (arrow/chevron/plus), position, radius, padding
  • Overlay Gradient: Subtle gradient over images for better text readability
  • Native Gutenberg block — drag, drop, configure
  • Elementor widget — drag into any page or section
  • Server-side rendered for reliable WooCommerce data
  • Responsive: up to 4 slides per view with per-breakpoint control
  • Autoplay, loop, touch/swipe, mouse drag
  • Configurable arrow navigation
  • Category filtering: include, exclude, parent-only, hide empty
  • Product display: price, rating stars, sale badge
  • Image shape: circle, rounded, square
  • Image size: small, medium, large, original
  • Shadow, radius, and padding controls
  • HTML anchor and custom CSS class support
  • Accessible markup with ARIA labels
  • Live preview in editor with interactive scroll slider
  • Assets loaded only when the block is on the page
  • Fully scoped CSS — no theme conflicts
  • Translated into German, English and French
  • Dashboard settings page with quick-start guide
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  4. In the block editor, search for Amitry Product & Category Slider and insert the block
  5. Choose “Categories” or “Products” mode and configure in the Inspector panel
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active. The plugin displays WooCommerce product categories and products, so it cannot function without it.

Can I use the plugin with any theme?

Yes. The plugin ships with fully scoped CSS that does not conflict with your theme styles. It works with block themes and classic themes alike.

Does the plugin work with page builders?

The plugin is primarily built as a native Gutenberg block. Most page builders allow you to embed Gutenberg blocks, so it should work in most environments.

How many slides can I show per view?

Up to 4 slides per view in the free version, with separate settings for desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Are the plugin assets loaded on every page?

No. CSS and JavaScript are only loaded on pages that actually contain the block. This keeps the rest of your site fast.

Does the plugin support translations?

Yes. The plugin ships with German, English, and French translations. The text domain is amitry-product-category-slider.

Is the plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with both High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart/Checkout Blocks.

Where can I report a bug or request a feature?

Please use the plugin support forum on WordPress.org or contact us at info@amitry.de.
